name: Spider Electronics
old_description: Spider Electronics specializes in sourcing and procuring electronic components and devices for manufacturers worldwide. Whether you need standard or custom products, our extensive supplier network ensures that you receive high-quality components that meet your exact specifications.
about:
Spider Electronics was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Plainfield, Illinois. The company began as an electronics procurement specialist, drawing on over 25 years of experience in international development and sourcing to connect manufacturers with component suppliers worldwide.

The firm operates a global procurement network with strategic offices across Asia, providing access to a vast supplier base for standard and custom electronic components and devices. Services include component sourcing, procurement management, warehousing with products ready to ship, and expert consultation for product development and supply chain challenges. All suppliers are vetted to meet ISO standards and various agency certifications.

Spider Electronics serves manufacturers worldwide, including top U.S. brands that rely on the same trusted manufacturing partners. Its customer base spans original equipment manufacturers and other electronics producers seeking reliable component supply chains.

The company emphasizes reliability, transparency, and efficiency in every step of the procurement process, offering competitive pricing through global sourcing and custom solutions tailored to exact specifications.
